summary: WF Holding Limited, a Malaysian foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K on October 15, 2026 disclosing a registered direct offering of 12,000,000 units at $1.50 per unit (or $1.499 per unit with a pre-funded warrant), each unit comprising one ordinary share (or a pre-funded warrant at $0.001 exercise) and one warrant exercisable at $1.50 until October 14, 2027. Aggregate gross proceeds were approximately $18.0 million, before placement agent fees and expenses. Univest Securities, LLC acted as Placement Agent. Net proceeds are intended for working capital and general corporate purposes. The Company agreed to a 30-day standstill on new equity issuances and a 45-day suspension of its Javelin equity line. Directors, officers, and 5% holders entered lock-up agreements. This is a capital-raising event, not a special situation.
